title: Cylindrical base
spec: Create a cylindrical base by following these detailed steps. First, establish a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on a new face. Within this face, create a single loop and draw a circle centered at coordinates (0.0238, 0.0238) with a radius of 0.0238 units. Apply a scaling factor of 0.0476 to the two-dimensional sketch to adjust its size. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using the Euler angles and translating it using the translation vector defined in the coordinate system. Finally, extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units to generate the three-dimensional model. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction, creating a new solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical base are 0.047625 units in length, 0.047625 units in width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0238, 0.0238)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0238)  # Draw the circle
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = (
    sketch
    .extrude(0.75, taper=0.0476)  # Extrude with taper
)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

# Display the final model

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a circle with the specified center and radius

# Extrude the circle to create a cylinder
